name: served by everyone
headline: Served by *everyone*
say: Shared work is carried by the people who use it. Hosts are run by those people, and publishing puts each piece up under its own signature before a pointer moves to the new version, so older versions keep working. Work is copied from host to host, and every copy is checked against its signature, so the more people care about something, the more places it lives. Trust is an allowance you give each peer, never a switch that is on by default. And nothing about you is tracked: not one statistic is collected. Your work is served by everyone who cares about it, and kept safe by your peers.
